<a id="summary"></a>

## Summary

Versioned registered-adapter metadata and usual storage hints, without implicit source discovery.

<a id="goals"></a>

## Goals

- Programs can discover supported adapters and choose explicit source locations from structured hints.

<a id="non-goals"></a>

## Non-goals

- No additional source adapters, private-store scanning, automatic location expansion or plugin loader.
- No persisted CLI resume, revision reconciliation or lossless archival.
